claim.value: Flakiness, unbuildable revisions, several regressions, later fixes and interactions can leave several candidate boundaries.
claim.scope: Possible nonunique localization under the listed complications.

provenance.rationale: P031 explicitly identifies the listed complications and multiple candidate boundaries as a possible outcome.

signal_basis.value: Revision tests yield good, bad or inconclusive classifications. Elimination relies on a single transition; inconclusive tests and build failures do not justify discarding history, and infeasible further classification leaves an unresolved interval.
signal_basis.scope: Classification and interval narrowing within the tested revision history.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the classification outcomes, single-transition restriction, non-elimination rules and unresolved-interval stopping condition.
The bounded possibility claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Unreliable or unavailable classifications can leave multiple transition locations compatible with the evidence. Several regressions, later fixes or interactions can undermine the single-transition assumption and permit multiple candidate boundaries. This licenses the stated possibility of nonunique localization.
uncertainty: The claim does not establish that any listed complication actually occurs or that every occurrence produces multiple candidates.
